stage1.impression: A warm, plausible night bar. The fluted oak front, the record wall and the speakers in their timber niches give it some character, but it reads as a careful CG render, not a photograph. The pendants are flat white milk-glass discs, there is a blank white card blown out above the left speaker, the zinc top is a smooth flat grey, the glasses repeat as dark cylinders, and the right third is an empty brown void. The smoked speakers read as grey PA boxes, not as glowing tinted acrylic. A magazine would see the bones of a specific place (speakers set into niches either side of a record wall, like a Tokyo kissa), but this frame looks like a generic bar render.

blocking_9: The left speaker reads at a glance as tinted cast acrylic with light inside it (batts and horn visible through a smoked, glowing cabinet). Its region's lum_median is 55 or more, and nothing above it is a flat white card.
The Dome pendants read as smoked acrylic with a soft frosted glow (shade median 150 to 195), not as uniform white milk-glass discs.
The zinc counter shows real patina, wipe marks and soft, uneven reflections, with its top's median 85 to 115, not a flat bright grey slab.
The right third of the frame has a pool of light or a lit surface in it (lum_range of 85 or more), not an empty void.
The shell (board-formed concrete, fir beams, blackened steel) is visible somewhere in the frame, so the room reads as this specific place.
No chroma grain or denoiser smear on the fluted front, the record spines or the back wall.
Props are varied and look used (ice, different fill levels, a lit candle flame visible), not six identical dark tumblers.

defects.what: A flat, featureless white plane above the left speaker (median 224, almost no texture) reads as a blank CG card or a blown niche strip.
The Dome pendant glows as uniform white milk glass (median 215), with no smoked tint or frosted gradation. The same on the other three Domes.
The second Dome has the same flat white disc (median 214).
The hero speaker is grey and flat (median 44.5, under the 45 target). It reads as a black PA box, not tinted acrylic with light through it. The frame's top edge cuts off its top.
The zinc top is a smooth, bright, uniform grey (median 134, p95 210). It reads as plaster or concrete, not patinated zinc. It has no wipe marks and no rim reflections.
The right back is an empty dark brown void (median 36, range only 67): no pool of light and no detail.
Visible chroma grain and blotchy noise on the fluted oak front and the counter edge.
Record spines are soft and smeared by the denoiser, with repetitive spine patterns.
Rocks glasses repeat as near-identical dark opaque cylinders. They read as the same model copied, not as drinks.
The record player's clear cover reads as a shop display case on the counter.
No board-formed concrete, fir beam or blackened steel is visible apart from a sliver of concrete under the record wall, so the room reads as a generic oak-panelled bar.

changes.problem: A flat white card above the hero speaker pulls the eye away and says 'render'.

evidence.measured: lum_median 224, p95 227, neutral RGB 224/224/222, no texture

changes.expected: The niche's top reads as a soft warm graze on oak, not a white panel. The speaker's top edge separates from it.

changes.problem: The hero speaker is too dark and flat to read as glowing smoked acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 44.5 (target 45 or more); driver area median 100 is the only bright part; cabinet sides near 40

change.setting: lamps on each speaker (area, W/m2 at the target)
change.to: 3.0 W/m2, 2700 K, placed above and behind the cabinet so light passes through the acrylic and lights the batts

changes.expected: The cabinet walls glow smoky brown-grey, with edges catching light and batts visible inside. The speaker becomes the hero read.

changes.problem: The Dome pendants read as cheap white milk-glass discs, not smoked acrylic.
changes.expected: The shades read as darker smoked acrylic with a softer frosted glow inside, and the rim catches light.

changes.problem: The zinc top is a flat, bright grey slab with no patina, so it reads as plaster.

evidence.measured: lum_median 134, p95 210, smooth with no variation at 1:1

change.setting: zinc patina, plus the Domes' downlights
change.to: darker zinc (base about #5A5752) with a roughness map from 0.25 to 0.5, wipe marks and ring stains; downlights 22 W, so pools of light form under each Dome

changes.expected: The top reads as worn zinc, with soft reflections of the glasses and distinct pools of light under the pendants that fall off between them.

changes.problem: The right third of the frame is an empty brown void with no pool of light.

change.setting: the record wall's spots and the haze
change.to: 4 x 8.0 W, cone 22 deg, aimed so one spot grazes the far right wall; haze 0.006 per metre

changes.expected: A grazed pool on the back wall and visible light shafts under the far Domes give the right side depth.

changes.problem: The frame cuts off the hero speaker and the pendant at the top and shows none of the concrete, fir or steel shell, so the place reads as generic.

evidence.measured: The speaker's top and the first Dome are cut by the frame's top edge. No beam or board-formed concrete is visible.

change.to: position [3.4, 2.7, 1.30], target [7.4, 5.6, 1.65], 35 mm, verticals kept true (shift rather than tilt)

changes.expected: The whole speaker sits in its niche with headroom, a fir beam and the ceiling's line show at the top, and the counter takes less of the frame.

changes.problem: The glasses repeat as identical dark cylinders and read as copied models.

evidence.measured: Six rocks glasses with near-identical dark fill and silhouettes

change.to: 3 rocks with different fill levels (one with a large clear ice cube, one with an amber spirit catching light, one empty), 2 coupes, a lit votive in the foreground pool, the record sleeve leaned against the decks

changes.expected: Glasses catch small highlights and read as a night in progress.

changes.problem: Chroma grain on the oak front and denoiser smear on the record spines say 'render'.

evidence.measured: Blotchy colour noise visible in the 2x crop; median 39, a dark region where the noise shows most

change.to: samples 768, adaptive 0.01, clamp 6, then fine monochrome film grain added in the grade

changes.expected: Clean fluting and crisp record spines, with grain that reads as film rather than render noise.

out_of_scope.request: Make the R3 Float's clear cover read less like a display case (thicker, with polished glowing edges).
out_of_scope.why: It is EARF's product. Its shape and parts are fixed.

out_of_scope.request: Show more board-formed concrete, fir beams and blackened steel in the counter and back-bar zone.
out_of_scope.why: The room's design and materials are fixed. Only the camera (c6) can bring more of the shell into frame.

out_of_scope.request: Give the speakers a saturated tint so the frame's one colour comes from them.
out_of_scope.why: The Smoke configuration is fixed. With smoked products the frame has no saturated colour, by design.
